sources.entry: Cerebras-GPT - Cerebras Systems provides open-source GPT models optimized for their AI-specific hardware. While designed for large-scale deployment, Cerebras-GPT models can also be run on specific compatible local setups, making it suitable for research or enterprise applications.

summary.name: Cerebras
summary.one_liner: Cerebras is an AI inference provider built around its wafer-scale chip hardware, marketed for very fast model responses compared with GPU-based systems.
use_cases: Running low-latency LLM inference for coding assistants
Speeding up multi-step AI agent workflows
Accelerating enterprise AI search and copilots
Running scientific models such as drug response prediction
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes Cerebras as a provider of fast AI inference running on its wafer-scale chip, with the CS-4 system named as delivering up to 30x faster inference than GPUs. It lists use cases including code generation, multi-step agent workflows, complex reasoning, and voice responses. Customer testimonials cite speeds such as over 2,000 tokens per second for Meta's Scout model and about 1,000 tokens per second for an agent. A disclaimer states that speed comparisons come from third-party benchmarks or internal testing and vary by workload. The page also mentions partnerships with OpenAI, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and AWS, though it gives few technical specifics beyond these claims.
notable: Claims up to 30x faster inference than GPU systems, per vendor benchmarks
Cloud partnerships with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and AWS
Cerebras-GPT open-source GPT models, per an awesome-ai-tools listing
caveats: Speed claims come from third-party benchmarks or internal testing and may vary by workload and model
Pricing and access terms are not stated on the page
Hardware-focused; the page gives few details on how individuals can use the service
